notes: Glucose-to-acetate diauxie time course in MOPS minimal (30 mM acetate + 0.61 mM glucose). Pre-shift = control. 5-120 min after glucose run-out = carbon_starvation (glucose exhaustion); growth_phase kept as mid_exponential for these by the <=2 h time-course rule, although the cells are in the diauxic transition. Post-shift steady growth on acetate: treatment none, is_control true (plain steady growth), carbon_source organic_acid. Temperature, aeration and culture vessel not stated.

base_medium.q: grown on MOPS minimal media with 30 mM acetate and 0.61 mM glucose
